purpose: Translations for already resolved German lemmas/POS only; no morphology index.

source.release_note: Public page dated extraction 2026-10-02, dump 2026-10-01; local file identified by checksum, remote byte identity not checked.

attribution: Russian Wiktionary contributors; extracted and postprocessed via Wiktextract / Kaikki.org.
conversion_notice: Translation projection and partitioning; source texts and selected fields preserved. Display eligibility annotations added; original JSONL unchanged.

projection.omitted: All unlisted entry/sense fields, including forms, audio, etymology, relations and categories. Original JSONL remains the complete source.
projection.identity: 1-based JSONL record_id plus 0-based sense_index; source sense.id is not unique.
projection.case_policy: Exact source spelling retained. No lowercase alias index; caller must handle casing and POS conservatively.

display_policy.translation: Eligible, not a guarantee of correctness.
display_policy.reviewed-pos-conflict: Excluded; source POS is preserved, not corrected.

reviewed_sense_ids.ru-sein-de-verb-yBJK18UD: Possessive pronoun incorrectly labelled verb; do not relabel automatically.
reviewed_sense_ids.ru-sein-de-verb-ReCTCr6o: Possessive pronoun incorrectly labelled verb; do not relabel automatically.

routing: FNV-1a 32-bit over exact UTF-8 key bytes; hash & 1023

labels.field: sense.labels = [[gloss_index, cut, [codes]], ...]; only on senses that have labels; gloss text unchanged; gloss[cut:] is the translation without the labels.
labels.recognition: only listed abbreviations at the very start of a gloss, separated by spaces/commas; text must remain after them; not when the rest starts with «от »/«к » (form descriptions).
labels.english_dictionary_codes: style/region codes are the same as senses.usage in dictionary-de-json where they exist

name_like.field: sense.name_like = [kind, category]; kind: place | person | astronomy | deity; category: Russian Wiktionary category without "/de"
name_like.rule: NOUN record in a name category of Russian Wiktionary (cities, toponyms, states, given names, surnames, rivers, mountains, planets, constellations, stars, gods …) AND the translation (after G17 labels) starts with a capital letter or names itself («(фамилия)», «(мужское имя)», «город X»). Russian Wiktionary lists these as nouns; the reader ignores the key.

reflexive.field: sense.reflexive = [[gloss_index, "acc"|"dat"|"opt", pattern], ...]; verb senses only; gloss text unchanged
reflexive.note: matched on the gloss after sense.labels cut; «(sich)» in Russian Wiktionary marks a reflexive verb, not an optional one; «(тж. sich)» = also reflexive -> opt

review.rule: every mark checked by two independent reviewers (this sense used with sich? type acc/dat/opt right? meaning text sensible?); keep if both keep; change if both give the same new type; remove if either says remove or they disagree whether the sense is reflexive. Amendment (advisor 27.10): both reflexive but different type -> acc+opt gives acc; where one said dat, a third reviewer decided (final)

reading.field: sense.reading = "separable" | "inseparable" (last key); translation senses of doublet verbs only; texts unchanged
reading.rule: Russian Wiktionary entry forms: "setzt über" / "übergesetzt" -> separable; all forms start with the prefix and none with prefix+ge -> inseparable; no forms -> no field; each value checked by two independent reviewers, kept only if both agree
